o.text: From German Filiale, from Latin fīliālis (“of or pertaining to a son or daughter”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طُوزْ (doz), from Proto-Common Turkic *tōz.
From Proto-Common Turkic *bīn-. Cognate with Crimean Tatar minmek (“to get on”), Uzbek minmoq (“to get on”).
From Persian خبردار (xabardâr). By surface analysis, xəbər + -dar.
Borrowed from Russian бренд (brend), English brand.
